name: docker-safeguard
description: Backs up any Docker app's appdata and full configuration (image, ports, env vars, mounts, the Unraid template itself) into one archive, and restores it elsewhere so the app comes back up instantly runnable with the same data and options. Save backups to any Unraid share or an external USB/NVMe/HDD.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Needed to inspect, create, and start containers

paths.name: User Shares
paths.description: Read appdata and write backups to any share

paths.name: Unassigned Disks
paths.description: Backup to/restore from a USB/NVMe/HDD mounted via Unassigned Devices

paths.name: Unassigned Remotes
paths.description: Backup to/restore from a mounted network remote

paths.name: unRAID Docker Templates
paths.description: Read/write unRAID's own per-container template XML for high-fidelity backup and restore

paths.name: App Config
paths.description: Docker Safeguard's own settings, job history, and login

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the Docker Safeguard web interface
